name: Adultery Pregnancy
overview: Scripture clearly condemns adultery as a grave sin against God's design for marriage, commanding in Exodus 20:14 and Deuteronomy 5:18 not to commit adultery. The law in Leviticus 20:10 and Deuteronomy 22:22 prescribes severe consequences for those who engage in adultery, reflecting the seriousness of violating the marital covenant. Proverbs 6:32 highlights the spiritual ruin that adultery brings upon the sinner, while Ezekiel 23:37 connects the sin to both moral and spiritual corruption, including the tragic consequences for offspring. Together, these verses underscore that adultery and any resulting pregnancy are matters of profound sinfulness and judgment in the biblical worldview.
